obernants.operator: The recurrence oracle appends terms sequentially with lagged dot products, never polynomial reduction. The convolution oracle uses independent schoolbook index summation, never transforms. Shared primitive arithmetic is a remaining assumption; finite exhaustive inputs are explicitly bounded.
